MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 40.5

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 18
   C. 45
   D. 36

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

16. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
